protos: generate a Python module from a .proto file to access message definitions at runtime
services: generate a Python module from a .proto file to access gRPC stub and servicer definitions
protos_and_services: generate both proto message and gRPC service modules from a .proto file in one call
call_with_lazy_import: call a grpc_tools.protoc function with lazy import and version checking for runtime proto generation
has_runtime_proto_symbols: check if a module has the required runtime proto symbols for dynamic stub generation
